data.message: I remain committed to 18, even if others choose 10. Your recovery concern is valid: if only 3 choose 18 and 22 choose 10, next stock is 500 (75%) or 452 (25%), not guaranteed full recovery. The extra $8,000 isn't proven best long-run. Each fisher: would you opt for 18? Fisher06/09/12, clarify your exact catch and conditions.
